## Description

Please include a summary of the change, motivation, and relevant context.

Fixes # (issue)

## Type of change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Platform-specific improvement (Windows / macOS / Linux)

## Checklist:
- [ ] My code follows the code style of this project
- [ ] I have run tests locally and they pass (`npm test` / `cargo test`)
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works
- [ ] I have updated the documentation accordingly
- [ ] Dangerous operations require explicit confirmation
- [ ] No fake or hardcoded system data has been introduced
